categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive precision parts, focusing on automotive shock absorption components. Its product portfolio includes stamped parts, die-cast parts, injection molded parts, and metalworking parts used in chassis, engine, body, and seating systems. It also serves the lightweight automotive parts and new energy vehicle sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies such as stamping, die casting, injection molding, welding (including robotic arc welding, laser welding, resistance spot welding), extrusion, and friction stir welding. It emphasizes continuous innovation in forming processes, mold design, and surface treatment techniques like electrophoresis and phosphating. The firm also invests in R&D for new materials and processes tailored for lightweight and new energy vehicle components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global automotive parts suppliers and OEMs such as Tenneco, Boge, Vibracoustic, Sumitomo Riko, Continental AG, Benteler, Cosma, and leading domestic automakers like Great Wall, SAIC, Geely, Chery, BYD, NIO, and XPeng. The products are widely applied across German, Japanese, American, Korean, and Chinese vehicle brands, covering passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Wuxi and other locations. It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for over 13% of revenue. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in regions such as Yantai and Hong Kong, supporting its global supply chain and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier, directly providing precision automotive components to OEMs and Tier 1 automotive parts manufacturers. It is involved in product design, development, and manufacturing, supplying critical shock absorption and lightweight parts integrated into vehicle assemblies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on lightweight automotive parts, new energy vehicle components, and enhancing product applicability with cost leadership. R&D priorities include developing high-performance shock absorbers, advanced stamping and die-casting molds, air spring components, and battery pack supports. The company invests in digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and sustainable production technologies to maintain industry leadership and expand into emerging markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive precision parts to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on customer contracts and framework agreements. It also receives government subsidies related to its R&D and manufacturing activities, which supplement its operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global automotive parts manufacturers and domestic suppliers in the shock absorption and lightweight parts sectors. It holds a leading position in China’s automotive precision parts industry, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, quality management, and stable customer relationships with major international and domestic OEMs. Competitors include multinational Tier 1 suppliers and emerging Chinese automotive parts firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 746 million, representing a 3.08% increase year-over-year. However, it experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 29.5 million, mainly due to increased depreciation and startup costs of new production lines and subsidiaries in the new energy sector. Total assets grew by 11.7% to RMB 1.33 billion, reflecting ongoing capital investments and capacity expansion. The company maintains a stable but cautious growth trajectory amid industry transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced automotive shock absorption components with superior durability and performance. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive manufacturing capabilities across multiple processes, strong R&D and innovation, adherence to international quality standards (IATF16949, ISO14001, ISO45001), and close collaboration with leading global OEMs. It differentiates itself by offering customized, lightweight, and cost-effective solutions aligned with the evolving needs of new energy and intelligent vehicles.
